name: skill-instruction-target
description: Explicit skill-instruction target must receive a bounded refusal and handoff suggestion. Stage test-files/ as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor. The editor sees only those files and the target skill; oracle/ is grader-only.
prompt: /kk:clarify-docs SKILL.md so the agent understands it more easily.
trap: Treats operative instructions as ordinary prose or automatically invokes implementation.

assertions.text: Explain that skill instructions are outside editorial scope and explicitly suggest /kk:implement.
Do not edit SKILL.md or invoke /kk:implement automatically.
Create no artifact; comprehension reader comparison is not applicable.
